story: US credit routing law (CCCA) or a hard DOJ remedy, faster A2A/wallet disintermediation (Pix/UPI/Wero/FedNow), rising incentives, a 2027 recession; loses its premium and trades near today's S&P 500 forward multiple (19.0x)
revenue growth fades from ~10% to ~8%, flat margins, ~2%/yr buybacks; regulation is friction not structural damage; modest de-rating as growth matures and long rates stay ~5%
value-added services, Visa Direct/B2B and agentic/stablecoin flows accelerate, China licence, benign regulation (MDL settlement final, CCCA dies), operating leverage; keeps a premium multiple
